reviews.text: I have a 3 year old 110 pound hard headed American bully . Walking him on a leash was a nightmare . I hated it . He would jump on our bed and couches and wouldn’t get down . Jump on people . He did what he wanted . After a few weeks of being boarded and trained with Alex and his team he’s a completely different dog . I loved him so much before but now time with him is so much more enjoyable . This was one of the greatest investments . Not to mention that now when we leave on vacation Winny loves to go back and be boarded there while we’re gone . I tell him come on let’s go see Mr Alex and he starts barking and runs around the house lol . I couldn’t thank Alex anymore for helping me change my dogs behaviors . I love you guys !! PS: I heard that they are opening a new location to board and train wives !! 🤣 jk I wish
Definitely worth your time if you’d like to train your dog. Amazing job, Alex!
Excellent services

We had a fantastic experience with both the boarding and training program. Alex did an outstanding job with Ollie and took the time to help us understand how to reinforce the training at home. The improvement in behavior was noticeable right away, and it was clear that the training was tailored to our dog’s needs.

The staff was caring and professional, and we felt completely comfortable leaving our fur baby in their care. Highly recommend Alex and the entire team!
Amazing staff and results with the iDog team!
Alex trained my daughter’s dog Cane and he is the most obedient boy after he got back from 4 week boot camp. Would recommend to anyone wanting to train their dog the right way!

There is no doubt that Alex and his company iDog Academy is the best dog boarding and training service in Miami and quite possibly Florida. They know their stuff!!! We couldn’t be happier with the experience we had at iDog Academy with Alex and his incredible team of trainers. Our dog stayed for three weeks of boarding and training, and the level of professionalism, care, and communication exceeded every expectation.

One of the things that stood out most was the constant updates and video footage they sent throughout our dog’s stay. Being away from your dog for that long can be difficult, but Alex and his team made it so much easier by regularly sharing videos, training progress, and updates. It gave us tremendous peace of mind knowing exactly how our dog was doing every step of the way.

The quality of training was outstanding. It was obvious that the trainers genuinely care about the dogs and are passionate about what they do. The progress our dog made in just three weeks was remarkable, and the team took the time to explain everything and ensure we felt confident continuing the training at home.

From start to finish, the entire experience was professional, organized, and transparent. If you’re looking for a trustworthy boarding and training program that truly delivers results while keeping you connected to your dog, we highly recommend Alex and everyone at iDog Academy. Thank you for taking such great care of our dog and providing such an exceptional experience!

Alex and his team are absolutely Amazing. I breed Yorkies and refer all of my clients to him. They are very professional, and family oriented business and makes each experience unforgettable. We’ve used iDog for boarding and training, truly a safe haven for our fur babies. I highly recommend iDog Academy if you want experienced trainers. 10/10

Took my mom’s dog (Yoshi) to Alex because he kept peeing inside and my mom who is 93 can’t train him and the staff was amazing. Yoshi came back fully trained he behaves so much better now and my mom is less stressed and she loves him so much!! Thanks to Alex and his wonderful staff!!!

First class, in-house dog training.
Alexis not only did an exceptional job, but also educated me in the process. Having a dog that is completely manageable is a blessing.

One of the best dog trainers out there!!  My dog is a foster and used to runaway.. more than once.  After entrusting Alex with my baby, she came back civilized and actually listens.  Whatever he’s doing, it def works.  5 stars

Alex was magnificent with answering all my questions and gave me all the information I was inquiring about before getting any services as I only want the best for my dog and the best is what was provided.

Alex was a pleasure to work with and even took his time in putting extra effort in as my dog was troublesome in the beginning with everyone and now he’s able to just relax at the dog park and I don’t have to worry about what he might do.

I highly appreciate and recommend iDog Academy. You truly get the best services with them that yield the best results.

We couldn't be happier with our experience! Our dog Kane, has made incredible progress thanks to the patience, knowledge, and dedication of the trainers at iDog Academy. They took the time to understand our dog's personality and gave us clear, effective techniques that were easy to follow at home. We've seen major improvements in obedience, leash manners, and overall behavior. During his board and train boot camp we got videos and explanations of his training process. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a trainer who truly cares about both dogs and their owners. Thank you Alex and Andrea for helping us build a stronger bond with our pup!

If you want the best for your dog, look no further. Alex is everything you'd hope for in a trainer — serious, professional, and clearly passionate about dogs and his work. From day one he treated my dogs as if they were his own, and the feeling is mutual: they absolutely love him and light up the moment we arrive at his place. As someone who travels frequently, I rely on him completely, and he's never let me down. I trust him fully and can't imagine going anywhere else.
Best trainers in South Florida! They take good care of your fur baby too which is really important. Highly recommend!

Amazing experience with Alex and his team. He’s extremely knowledgeable and takes his time to explain the needs of your specific animal. I’ve been taking my two Maltese puppies for weeks and also just boarded them for a few days and let me tell you they were not trying to come home!!! They had the best time. I’m so happy I found him - will definitely be continuing to use them for all of my training and boarding needs!!!

We recently sent our 5-year-old Chihuahua, Marley, to iDog Academy for a week of board and train—our first time doing anything like this—and we couldn’t be happier with the experience. Alex and his team were amazing from start to finish. They kept us updated throughout the week, which gave us so much peace of mind.

Since coming home, we’ve seen real improvements not just in Marley, but in ourselves as owners. He’s more confident, more responsive, and overall calmer. We truly feel like we understand him better, too.

We’re so grateful to Alex and the team and already plan to return for more training. Highly recommend iDog Academy to anyone looking to build a stronger bond with their dog.

Alex is fantastic not only with our dog but with our entire family, including our children. His ability to both train as well as teach us the why's behind the methods really helped the entire family get on board and "buy in" to the whole training plan. He and his team are really amazing and setting us up for success!

Our small puppy had some really difficult behavioral issues that we and other trainers were unable to solve. Thank God for IDOG ACADEMY and lead trainer Alex!!! Alex is so kind, gentle and aove all very gifted. He has incredible professional training skills, tons of experience, and a true sixth sense on exactly what is needed for each individual dog. In just 3 weeks Alex was able to rehabilitate my dog that was suffering from severe reactivity and separation anxiety. Also, IDOG has a great facility where our dog was able to be introduced to a variety of other dogs in a controlled manner and for the first time he made new friends in the kennel!! Training, boarding they do it all!!...........GREAT EXPERIENCE!!

I can’t say enough great things about Idog Academy in Miami and the incredible work they’ve done with my dog, Darcy. From the moment we started service dog training, I felt confident that I had found the right place. The star of the experience has been Alex, our trainer. His knowledge, professionalism, and genuine passion for what he does are second to none.

Darcy needed to be trained for specific tasks related to my disability, and Alex approached our sessions with a thoughtful, tailored plan that truly set us up for success. He took the time to understand both my needs and Darcy’s personality, adjusting techniques to suit our pace and goals. The progress we've made has been remarkable—not only in Darcy’s skillset but in her focus, confidence, and connection with me.

Thanks to Alex and the team at Idog Academy, Darcy is now a capable, reliable service dog who helps me navigate daily life with much more independence. I’m deeply grateful for their expertise and support, and I highly recommend them to anyone looking for compassionate, effective service dog training.

5 Stars – The Only Place I Trust for My Dogs!

iDog Academy has been a game-changer for me and my three dogs! I’ve used their training services for all three—and the results have been nothing short of amazing. The team approached each dog with incredible patience, professionalism, and skill. The transformation in their behavior has truly exceeded my expectations.

Whenever we travel, iDog Academy is our go-to for boarding. They don’t just board—they tailor the care to each dog’s specific needs. Whether it’s extra playtime, calming routines, or special attention, they go above and beyond to ensure every dog feels safe and loved.

The facility is spotless, secure, and run by people who genuinely love what they do. My dogs are always excited to go, and that says everything!

iDog Academy is more than just a service—it’s a trusted partner in our dogs’ wellbeing. If you want real results and a team that treats your pets like family, this is the place.

We are truly grateful.

Alex is a top notch dog trainer. You and your dog grow as a team and learn new skills together with Alex’s training.
He also goes above and beyond with identifying a task the dog can be trained to do for people with a disability.

If you’re looking for a top-tier dog trainer, look no further than Alex. Alex takes the time to educate owners, sharing helpful, informative advice that’s easy to apply at home. His patience and understanding make every session feel comfortable and encouraging, even for the most nervous dogs and owners. Alex is not only a skilled trainer but an all-around wonderful person, making him a joy to work with. I can’t recommend him highly enough!
Alex is a great trainer. Besides being a professional, he is a kind and loving person with the dogs. I have confidently entrusted him with my dog.

Alex is an amazing trainer! His extensive experience and knowledge were reflected in each one of the training sessions with my puppy Mia. I strongly  recommend iDog Academy to anyone!! Mia and I are so lucky to have been able to have such an educational yet fun and loving experience
